applies_why: The judge text rules that the curse limb was dropped, so there is no live link for the chain-against-chain collision the rule governs.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse
why: The judge relies on the dropped-link status, not on a retired stating-verse test or a verse-by-verse comparison.
